raw_text: r/cybersecurity — Anyone following the AIIMS Delhi situation? Multiple reports from Indian healthcare IT folks that the entire NIC network at AIIMS has been compromised. Ransomware variant appears to be a customized Wanna Cry derivative based on the encryption patterns. Their e-Hospital application is completely offline. This is critical infrastructure — AIIMS handles VIP patients including government officials. The attack vector might have been an unpatched server — AIIMS was reportedly running outdated Windows Server instances.
